notes.title: Voice Actor plays Vagabond Starship
notes.content:
Dan Weissenberger is a voice actor from the previous two games in the series and is playing the Vagabond Starship demo for the first time!

Vance Baryn, the series creator and developer will also be there for some fun discussions and answer questions about Vagabond Starship and the Sir Typhil's Tale series.

notes.title: Music Composer plays Vagabond Starship
notes.content:
Jon Paul Sapsford is composing music for Vagabond Starship and this is his first look at the demo!

Vance Baryn, the series creator and developer will also be there for some fun discussions and answer questions about Vagabond Starship and the Sir Typhil's Tale series.
